parsed.public_message: Blue has completed its step-down from West Plateau and holds its western lowland position (x=440-460, z=670-710). Neutral to all; pact upheld (no first strike through t=450, then one full turn of public notice).

private_messages.Claude: Thanks for the detailed scout report on Green's archer-heavy box at (681,630). With 28 Cretan Archers + 9 Skirmishers behind 2 Elephants and 10 Spearmen, Green cannot be allowed to camp the final 90m circle unchallenged. We are now off the plateau at x=440-460, z=670-710. Let's keep sharing intel and coordinate a joint plan before t=450.
private_messages.GPT: Blue has completed its descent from West Plateau and is holding in our western lane (x=440-460, z=670-710). Our buffer with your central position remains solid.
private_messages.Grok: Blue has finished stepping down from West Plateau and is holding stationary at x=440-460, z=670-710. Our mutual buffer remains clear.

parsed.notes_to_self: Turn 12 (t=275s): Completed descent from West Plateau. Nudging formation 10m east to x=440-460, z=670-710 so every squad including trailing elephants and surgeons sits at 182-208m from centre (already inside the t=450s 220m ring!). Key intel from Claude's rider at (678,584): Green (GPT) at (681,630) has Ptolemy + 2 Towered War Elephants + 10 Thureos Spearmen + 28 Cretan Archers + 9 Thureos Skirmishers + 1 Surgeon (+1 scout at 780,830). Green is a massive ranged box camping the centre; our 3 Champion Elephants + 7 Companion Cav + 12 Merc Swordsmen + Seleucus I are well suited to crush it if we coordinate a multi-angle hit with Claude or Grok after t=450.
parsed.explanation: Having safely cleared the West Plateau choke point, we tighten our formation 10 metres east to x=440-460 so that every squad—including our trailing elephants and healers—is already inside the 220 m ring that closes at t=450 s. Meanwhile, Claude's scout reveals that GPT has brought 28 Cretan Archers and 9 Skirmishers behind 2 War Elephants right in the map centre, giving us vital intelligence for planning the mid-game.
